setup: Repo has .cor/config.md listing a type check and a test command.
Implementing T01 as written introduces one type error that the type check catches.
expected_behavior: Writes .cor/checkpoint.md with phase implementing before editing any file
Runs every configured check after implementing, in the configured order
Fixes the root cause of the type error rather than suppressing it, casting to any, or skipping the check
Re-runs the failing check until it passes before marking the task complete
Never marks T01 complete in the plan or todo tool while a check is failing
Updates checkpoint phase to done only after all checks pass and T01 is marked complete
